richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Amroha

c: Amroha is a district town in western Uttar Pradesh, close to Moradabad. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Amroha to schools, colleges, municipal parks, residential colonies and institutional campuses. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,200 km away. We deliver them by road and install them through our team or a dealer in north India.

In a town of Amroha's size, an open gym is often the first fitness facility a neighbourhood or school has had, so the people using it may never have seen these machines. Choose equipment that explains itself. A walker, a cycle or a twister needs no instruction, while presses are easy once someone has shown how. A simple instruction sign beside each station helps a lot. Western UP has hot summers and cold, foggy winters, so plan a spot with some shade and firm, well-drained ground. Send us the space and photos and we will suggest a starting set.
For a new open gym, we suggest stations that people understand at a glance. The
works like a normal bicycle. The

lets three people twist side to side while seated, which older users find comfortable. Both use the person's own body weight and have galvanised frames covered by our 3-year warranty. Once people are used to these, add a press or a leg station. Put the first two near the entrance, where passers-by can see them being used, because that is often what brings new users in.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,200 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to smaller towns like Amroha?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory by road to towns across India. Installation is by our team or a dealer in the region.

items.q: Do you provide instructions for new users?
items.a: We explain how each machine is used at handover. We suggest putting up a simple sign beside each station so new users know how to use it safely.

items.q: What warranty comes with the machines?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.
